description: Why did revenue change? Price, volume, mix, currency, new and lost products - computed for you. Give the visual units and revenue by product or customer for two periods and it draws the price-volume-mix bridge finance teams otherwise build by hand in DAX: volume, mix, price, cost, currency, new and lost items, with the method named on the chart and every label adding up to the end total. Free features (every viewer, no licence, no time limit): Waterfall chart with thousands of steps, subtotals and totals (cumulative totals) from a step-type field or an "=" name prefix, start and end pillars, invert per step Variance bridges: budget to actual or prior year to actual by category, from a comparison measure or a Period field Vertical or horizontal orientation, Top N with Others, sorting (data order, largest impact, value, name), drilldown on the category hierarchy Lower is better for cost bridges, IBCS notation (PY, PL, FC, AC), hatched adverse bars Data labels (value, % of start or both) that add up after rounding, connectors, gridlines, automatic axis break, difference highlight in value and %, data table Legend (top or bottom), conditional formatting (fx rules, gradient or field value) on step colours, colour by direction or by effect and category One-line insight, four themes with their own personality or your report theme colours, every colour, font, label and axis adjustable…
